verdict.rationale: Google Calendar documents a RESTful API with events (single and recurring), free/busy queries for availability, push notifications, and incremental sync. Those are real building blocks for scheduling inside your own product. However, appointment booking pages appear only as a Workspace plan feature, with no evidence they are exposed through the API. Missing for 10: API management of event types/appointment schedules, a booking-specific API (slots, booking creation, confirmation), and independent corroboration of building scheduling products on it.

support.subject: As a developer, a documented REST API lets me manage event types, availability, and bookings programmatically — enough to build scheduling into my own product

citations.quote: The Google Calendar API is a RESTful API that can be accessed through explicit HTTP calls or using the Google Client Libraries.
Returns free/busy information for a set of calendars.
